description.zh: 企业标识，也称企业id，字符串形式，可在云效访问链接中获取，如https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】
description.en: The organization ID. You can obtain this ID from the URL of your organization's page on Alibaba Cloud DevOps. The URL is in the format of `https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/{organizationId}`.
